scenes.caption: This is LokalBot. Autocomplete for your whole Mac.
It remembers what your team decided, so it can finish the sentence for you.
It completes the word you're typing,
It reads the text before your cursor, and any saved notes that matter, like that pricing decision.
A small model, Gemma 4, runs right inside the app. No server, no cloud, no account.

scenes.caption: It weighs every possible next word. When it isn't sure, it stays quiet.
When it is, the rest appears in gray, and Tab takes it one word at a time.
LokalBot. Free, open source, and it runs on your Mac.
